logAuthoring.literalHelp: Case-sensitive literal term/phrase; internal spaces are exact. Quotes, OR and wildcards are literal. Existing queries keep this mode.
logAuthoring.messageHelp: Bare terms search message text and common error text. Use message: or another field name to target a field.
logAuthoring.fullTextHelp: Unlike bare terms, *: searches across all attributes in History. Live search does not support this condition.
logAuthoring.structuredHelp: Use fields, AND/OR/NOT, groups, quoted values, wildcards and numeric comparisons or ranges. Applied scope filters also apply.

logAuthoring.nested_path_unsupported: This nested path is unsupported. Use explicit [] steps and quoted child keys, with at most 4 keys.
logAuthoring.group_selection_unsupported: This Live backend cannot apply the exact group filter. Use History or explicitly remove the filter.
logAuthoring.collectionHelp: Use [] after a literal attribute or resource key to match a scalar or an immediate array member. Dots remain part of the key; arrays are not recursively flattened. Numeric predicates do not coerce strings.
logAuthoring.collectionBounds: Numeric query values and inclusive range bounds must be signed integers (absolute value at most 9007199254740992). One member must satisfy both bounds; grouped values may match different members. Decimal/exponent query numbers, unquoted text and wildcard operators are unsupported.
logAuthoring.collectionTextHelp: Quoted values match an exact, case-sensitive string scalar or immediate array member. "4" is text, distinct from numeric 4; "" matches an empty string, not a missing or null value. Quoted * and ? are literal characters.
logAuthoring.collectionNestedHelp: For nested values, write each literal child key in brackets and add [] after every key. Each step uses the scalar value or immediate array members; dots stay part of a key. Separate conditions may match different parent objects.
logAuthoring.collectionNestedBounds: Up to 4 keys (root plus 3 children), 256 characters per key and 1,024 total. Child keys must be quoted. Indices, wildcard keys, recursive traversal and conditions correlated to one parent object are unsupported.
